title: Manga Production Theatre — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The board flies in
scenes.purpose: Establish the backstage set: persistent director with clapperboard beside his speech balloon, five faceless crew in staggered lanes, and the presentation board arriving.
visuals: Stationary white paper set with ink fly rail, faint perspective lines and halftone floor
Board (flown flat with hangers and persistent ink drop-shadow) slides right-to-left into place 0-0.66s
Stage crew (box) makes a quick trip toward the board foot 0.10-0.36s, sets the box down 0.36-0.50s and returns 0.52-0.82s; status Ready > Delivering > Placed, orange badge dot only while working
Director balloon reads 'Let’s bring it to life.'; all other crew stay frozen

beats.development: Board slides in from the right carrying title, single IDEA node and caption; stage crew sets off with the prop box.
captions: DIRECTOR: Let’s bring it to life.

beats.development: Board settles; stage crew places the box and heads back; art dept begins its trip.
captions: One idea becomes a connected system.

scenes.title: Crew connect the idea
scenes.purpose: Show role-specific, staggered work turning the single idea into a connected network.
visuals: Art dept raises its oversized pencil and deliberately draws six links; four satellite nodes pop in 0.94-1.70s, then returns 1.72-2.00s
Lighting tilts the lamp toward the board 0.92-1.28s, lamp indicator and ink beam marks stay steady
Camera slowly tilts its twin-reel camera toward the board 1.22-2.20s (REC indicator while tracking), then locks off
Director snaps the clapperboard at 1.70s with a 2.5 degree nod, balloon updates to 'Now it’s a system.' with a brief orange underline and reaction marks
Sound pushes one mixer fader 2.00-2.22s and waits

beats.development: Art dept draws the network links on the board; lighting makes a short adjustment and holds; camera begins its slow tilt. Stage crew and sound stay still.
Network complete: director cue and single motivated reaction, dialogue changes, art returns, sound fader cue, camera locks off.

scenes.title: Settled system
scenes.purpose: Readable final frame: connected network on the board, director line, crew badges and final statuses all still.
visuals: All crew frozen at home positions with statuses Placed, Done, Lit, Waiting, Locked
Placed box remains by the board foot

beats.development: Reading hold of the settled composition.
captions: One idea becomes a connected system.

findings: Crew work windows are staggered: stage 0.10-0.82, art 0.62-2.00, lighting 0.92-1.28, camera 1.22-2.20, director 1.54-2.05, sound 2.00-2.22; idle crew are fully still outside their windows.
Only one reaction (director at the dialogue change); no synchronized bouncing and no callouts.
Board copy is static once the slide ends at 0.66s; the composition is fully settled by about 2.3s.
justifiedHolds: 2.3-3.0s final reading hold for board title, caption, dialogue and badges.

notes: Silent preview: no music, voice or sound effects; the sound crew's fader push is a visual cue only.

No reviewed preview recipes exist (STYLE.json tech.preview_recipes is absent; the task supplied an empty list), so the preview demonstrates the core Manga Production Theatre acting language plus a motion-012 style right-to-left board handoff.
Illustrative procedural scene drawn in HTML/CSS and inline SVG; not real production footage. Halftone is a CSS/SVG dot pattern.
